get.summary: List parcels
get.description: FARMER: only parcels of the household linked to the account. Other roles: all parcels. includeDeleted=true (ADMIN only, otherwise 403) also returns soft-deleted parcels.

post.description: FARMER or ADMIN only (ENGINEER gets 403). The code is generated (<HTX>-<household>-T<number>), never sent. latitude and longitude are required (400). FARMER: householdCode is ignored and the parcel belongs to the household linked to the account (403 if none is linked); the parcel is PENDING until an administrator approves it; gpsAccuracyMeters is required and must not exceed the configured limit, and mockedLocation=true is refused (422 GPS_ACCURACY_TOO_LOW, GPS_MOCKED); 422 TOO_MANY_PENDING_REQUESTS when the farmer already has the maximum of requests waiting. ADMIN: householdCode is required and the parcel is approved at once. With an Idempotency-Key, a repeated request returns the existing parcel; 409 if the key was used for another household.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID that makes retries of this request safe

post.summary: Send a rejected parcel again with corrected values
post.description: FARMER or ADMIN only. FARMER: 404 if the parcel belongs to another farmer. 409 unless the parcel is REJECTED. Same GPS and pending-request rules as creation.

post.summary: Ask to change the area or location of an approved parcel
post.description: FARMER or ADMIN only. The parcel keeps its values until an administrator approves the request (an ADMIN's own request applies at once). FARMER: 404 if the parcel belongs to another farmer. 409 unless the parcel is APPROVED or when a change request is already waiting. Same GPS and pending-request rules as creation.

get.summary: List crop seasons for a parcel
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the parcel belongs to another farmer. includeDeleted=true (ADMIN only, otherwise 403) also returns soft-deleted seasons.

post.summary: Start a new crop season for a parcel
post.description: FARMER or ADMIN only (ENGINEER gets 403). FARMER: 404 if the parcel belongs to another farmer; the season is PENDING until an administrator approves it. ADMIN: approved at once. The code is generated (<parcel code>-<year><DX|HT|TD>). riceVarietyCode must be in the catalogue (400). seasonType defaults to the one suggested by the start month (400 when the month matches none). expectedHarvestDate defaults to the suggested date; outside the growth range of the variety it needs reasonForOverride (400). 422 PARCEL_NOT_APPROVED while the parcel is not approved; 422 TOO_MANY_PENDING_REQUESTS when the farmer already has the maximum of requests waiting. 409 if the parcel already has an active crop season, or one of the same type in the same year. With an Idempotency-Key, a repeated request returns the existing season.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID that makes retries of this request safe

post.summary: Ask a question of the disease knowledge base
post.description: Any signed-in user. Returns the best matching passages of the corpus, each with the documents it is based on (title, organization, link, license, review status). Passages are quoted, never generated; the list is empty when nothing is relevant enough. 503 when the AI service is unavailable.

get.summary: List farm households
get.description: ENGINEER or ADMIN only.

post.summary: Create a household together with its FARMER account
post.description: ADMIN only. Creates the Keycloak user (temporary password, changed at first login) and links it to the new household. The temporary password is returned once. 409 if the username or email exists; 502 if Keycloak is unavailable (nothing is created).

post.summary: Farmer reports that the approved treatment was sprayed
post.description: FARMER only; 404 if the report belongs to another farmer. The report waits for an engineer (PENDING_CONFIRMATION) and blocks the harvest of the season until it is decided. Same dose and appliedAt rules as apply. 409 if the diagnosis is not approved, has no treatment rule, or already has a pending or confirmed spraying. A rejected report may be reported again.

post.summary: Engineer does not accept the spraying the farmer reported
post.description: 400 without a reason. 409 unless the report is waiting for confirmation. The harvest is no longer blocked by it and the farmer is notified.

post.summary: Engineer confirms the spraying the farmer reported
post.description: 409 unless the report is waiting for confirmation. The isolation runs from the spraying date the farmer gave. The farmer is notified.

post.summary: Record an engineer diagnosis, with optional symptom text
post.description: Preserves diagnosis history. Missing treatment rules produce review-only recommendations, never a fabricated dose or PHI.

post.summary: Rank catalog diseases from symptom text
post.description: RAG evidence only; scores are similarities, not diagnostic confidence. Does not save a diagnosis.

post.summary: Engineer rejects the recommendation (rejectedBy = logged-in engineer)
post.description: 409 if the diagnosis is not pending or was modified concurrently.

post.summary: Engineer approves the recommendation (approvedBy = logged-in engineer)
post.description: 409 if the diagnosis is not pending or was modified concurrently.

post.summary: Record actual treatment dose + compute harvest lock
post.description: appliedAt defaults to today (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh); 422 INVALID_APPLIED_AT if it is in the future or more than 30 days in the past. 409 if the diagnosis was already applied or the crop season was modified concurrently.

post.summary: Run or rerun AI diagnosis outside the database transaction
post.description: Preserves earlier diagnoses. 409 if a newer diagnosis arrives during inference or the report needs retake. Latest saved id is current.

post.summary: Check image quality and rice content without storing a report
post.description: Checks dimensions, brightness, sharpness and rice classification. Does not diagnose disease. AI failures return 503.

post.summary: Send a rejected crop season again with corrected values
post.description: FARMER or ADMIN only. FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer. 409 unless the season is REJECTED. Same rules as creation.

post.summary: Declare harvest (poka-yoke: 422 POKA_YOKE_VIETGAP_VIOLATION if still isolated)
post.description: FARMER or ADMIN only (ENGINEER gets 403). FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer. yieldKg is required; actualHarvestDate defaults to today (not in the future, at most 30 days back) and harvestedAreaHectares to the parcel area (400 above it). Before the expected date 422 HARVEST_TOO_EARLY unless confirmEarly=true comes with earlyReason. 422 TREATMENT_PENDING_CONFIRMATION while a spraying report waits for an engineer. An ADMIN must give reasonOnBehalf (400) and the farmer is notified. 409 if the season was modified concurrently.

get.summary: List disease reports for a crop season
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer; diagnosis is trimmed until APPROVED (see DiagnosisResponse). includeDeleted=true (ADMIN only, otherwise 403) also returns soft-deleted reports.

post.summary: Report a disease sighting with a photo (reportedBy = logged-in user)
post.description: FARMER only (ENGINEER and ADMIN get 403). 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer. With an Idempotency-Key, a repeated request returns the existing report without storing the image again; 409 if the key was used for another crop season or user. retakeOf links a replacement photo to a NEEDS_RETAKE report in the same season. Quality is rechecked server-side; poor images get 422. 422 CROP_SEASON_HARVESTED if the crop season is already harvested.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID that makes retries of this request safe

patch.summary: Reject a pending case; the requester sees the reason and may resubmit
patch.description: ADMIN only. 400 without a reason. 409 if the case is not pending, or its type is decided through its own endpoint (diagnoses).

patch.summary: Take a pending case (assignee = logged-in user)
patch.description: ENGINEER or ADMIN only. 409 if the case is not pending, or is already assigned to someone else (an ADMIN may take it over).

patch.summary: Approve a pending case and apply it to the entity it tracks
patch.description: ADMIN only. 409 if the case is not pending, or its type is decided through its own endpoint (diagnoses).
404 for a notification that belongs to another account.

patch.summary: Mark all my notifications as read
Link an existing Keycloak account to a household without one
patch.description: ADMIN only. Name the account by keycloakUserId or by username (exactly one, 400 otherwise). 409 if the household already has an account or the account is linked elsewhere; 404 if the household or Keycloak user does not exist.

Changes report status to NEEDS_RETAKE, cancels a diagnosis still waiting for approval, and notifies the household. Leaves diagnosis decisions unchanged. 409 if the current diagnosis is already APPROVED or a retake was already requested.

patch.summary: Move the expected harvest date of an active season
patch.description: FARMER or ADMIN only. newExpectedHarvestDate is today or later and at most 90 days ahead (400); reason is required. Each change is kept in the history. 409 unless the season is active.

get.summary: AI Service lấy treatment rule + lịch sử phun sau khi CV xác định disease_code
get.description: Gọi bằng service API key nội bộ (header X-Service-Api-Key), không dùng JWT người dùng.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Trace id xuyên suốt lượt gọi Backend<->AI

parameters.name: disease_code
parameters.description: Mã bệnh canonical do CV trả về, khớp Disease.code

parameters.name: crop_season_id
parameters.description: Vụ mùa của disease report đang được AI chẩn đoán

get.summary: List workflow cases, oldest first
get.description: ENGINEER or ADMIN only. Filter by caseType (e.g. DIAGNOSIS_APPROVAL), status and assignedTo (a user id, or `me`). size is capped at 100.

get.summary: Timeline of a case, oldest first
get.description: ENGINEER or ADMIN only. Events are never modified or removed.

get.summary: List all treatment rules
Status of the backend, AI service and photo storage
get.description: Public, no sign-in needed. Each service is UP or DOWN.

get.summary: List the rice varieties a crop season can use
get.description: Each variety carries its growth range in days and the source of the figures; reviewStatus IN_REVIEW means no agronomist has confirmed them yet.

get.summary: List all pesticides
Get a parcel by its business code (e.g. TD-01)
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the parcel belongs to another farmer.

get.summary: Current weather and 5-day forecast at the parcel position
get.description: Data from Open-Meteo, cached for an hour. When Open-Meteo cannot be reached the closest stored reference point is returned with isSnapshot=true and a note. FARMER: 404 if the parcel belongs to another farmer. 422 PARCEL_LOCATION_MISSING when the parcel has no GPS position.

get.summary: List my notifications, newest first
get.description: Only the signed-in account's own messages. unreadOnly=true hides the ones already read. size is capped at 100.

get.summary: Number of my unread notifications
List all diseases
The spraying recorded for a report
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the report belongs to another farmer. 404 when nothing was recorded yet.

get.summary: List all diagnoses for this report, newest first
get.description: Staff only. Earlier diagnoses and treatment locks are preserved.

get.summary: Get a disease report (with nested diagnosis if present)
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer; diagnosis is trimmed until APPROVED (see DiagnosisResponse).

delete.summary: Soft-delete a disease report entered by mistake

get.summary: Get crop season detail
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a crop season entered by mistake

get.summary: Check whether a crop season is still under pesticide isolation (PHI)
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer.

get.summary: History of expected harvest date changes, oldest first
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer.

get.summary: What to know before declaring a harvest
get.description: FARMER: 404 if the season's parcel belongs to another farmer. Returns how many days early today is, the isolation state and the open work (reports without a decision, approved recommendations not yet sprayed) that does not block the harvest.

get.summary: Suggested season type and harvest date for a variety and start date
get.description: seasonType is null when the start month matches no season window. 400 for a variety that is not in the catalogue.

get.summary: List requests with the parcel, season, diagnosis or spraying report behind each, oldest first
get.description: ENGINEER or ADMIN only. Filter by caseType (PARCEL_APPROVAL, PARCEL_EDIT_REQUEST, CROP_SEASON_APPROVAL, DIAGNOSIS_APPROVAL, TREATMENT_CONFIRMATION), status, householdCode, assignedTo (a user id, or `me`), unassigned=true and the day range from/to (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive). size is capped at 100.

get.summary: One request with its timeline
get.description: ENGINEER or ADMIN only. 404 for an unknown case id.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a parcel entered by mistake
delete.description: ADMIN only. 409 while the parcel still has crop seasons.

DiagnosisResponse.description: AI diagnosis of a disease report. For FARMER users, PENDING exposes only id, diseaseReportId and approvalStatus; REJECTED adds decidedAt and rejectionReason; every other field is null until APPROVED.
